en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_oral_ongoing: The adjustable-depth throat gag is set up before the training rack, and $names$ is pressed to her knees.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_oral_result: "The mouth is a toy's face. Today, we train it."
en-us.event_erav_sm_oral_01:
The training tool is an adjustable-depth throat gag. Kneeling before the rack, she takes him to the throat; each swallow deeper turns the lock another notch.
Her retching tears fall in strings while the old man's hands stay steady as a calligraphy teacher's.
"Breathe through the nose. Flatten the tongue. Time your swallow to my hand - there. That depth. Hold it."
en-us.event_erav_sm_oral_02:
Morning is deep-throat practice; afternoon is 'service etiquette': kiss the root before serving, bow, announce the count - "This is my nth service. Please treat me well."
An error in form means starting over. Over, and over.
en-us.event_erav_sm_oral_03:
The evening exam: he sits enthroned on the chair, and she must carry out the entire service routine unaided.
A retch means starting from the top. It takes her seven passes to pass.
en-us.event_erav_sm_oral_04:
"Qualified. ...Oh, right - you owe thanks for each attempt. Pay up."
"...Thank you... thank you for the training, Master..."
"Mm. The tongue is still stiff. We continue tomorrow."
en-us.event_erav_sm_oral_05:
At night her throat is so hoarse that even swallowing water hurts. The record gains a line: deep-throat passed; etiquette still needs polish.
On the whiteboard, tomorrow's subjects read: breasts and hips.
